nary_nodes.label: European heatwave in June
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
France saw its hottest day ever on average country-wide on 24 June, with temperatures hitting almost 41C in Paris and half the nation placed under a red heat alert.
This summer's record-breaking temperatures have already proved particularly deadly.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A prolonged period of abnormally hot weather.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents a heatwave; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Forecast for extreme weather in Europe
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
News of the death toll comes with parts of Europe, including the UK, braced for more searing temperatures from this weekend.
BBC Weather says a large area of high pressure is currently building from the Azores towards Portugal and Spain and that by the weekend, heat is forecast to climb across France and southern Britain.

And as Europe braces for sweltering conditions, millions of Americans celebrating the July Fourth holiday weekend are already being affected by prolonged extreme heat and high humidity in parts of the central and eastern US.
While the Netherlands is expecting a cooler week ahead, hot weather is predicted again over the weekend elsewhere.
Temperatures are forecast to reach 40C in the south of France, with peaks of 36C to 37C expected around Bordeaux, Toulouse and Agen.

Météo-France has issued red alerts for Friday and Saturday for forest fires in the southern part of the country, warning that weather conditions meant the risk of an outbreak was "very high" compared to summer norms.
In the Iberian Peninsula, Aemet weather service has warned of the possibility of another heatwave.
Portugal's government declared a state of alert which will remain in place until midnight on Tuesday.
Temperatures are forecast to exceed 40C in some areas, with overnight temperatures above 25C.
In Spain, areas of the southwest are on orange alert as 40C is expected in some parts.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a prediction or estimate of future weather conditions is made or communicated.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents a weather forecast event; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in France
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
Deaths rose 29% in the last week of June compared to the week before, with French health minister Stéphanie Rist adding there had been a "clear increase" in deaths among those over 45.
In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025 - nearly 30%, the Public Health France agency announced on Friday.
Deaths rose by 62% in the Paris region alone.
The French health ministry said the figure was likely an "underestimate" and mortality would "therefore be higher than these initial figures".
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event characterized by a number of deaths higher than expected for a given period.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents excess deaths; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in Belgium
evidence: Belgium recorded 1,222 excess deaths during the heatwave – 39% more than usual – with almost half being people aged 85 and over.
The country's health ministry said the number of deaths during a heatwave was "unprecedented".
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event characterized by a number of deaths higher than expected for a given period.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents excess deaths; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in Netherlands
evidence: Meanwhile, unprecedented heat in the Netherlands last week led to about 480 excess deaths, Dutch authorities said on Thursday - most of whom were aged 80 and older.
Temperatures reached almost 40C in parts of the country, with most of the deaths reported in the south and east of the Netherlands where temperatures were highest.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event characterized by a number of deaths higher than expected for a given period.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents excess deaths; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Drowning deaths in France
evidence: Drowning deaths soared during the heatwave, with French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez saying on Saturday that 72 people had died by drowning since 18 June.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event involving deaths caused by drowning.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org Event subtype specifically represents drowning deaths; Event is the appropriate parent.

nary_nodes.label: Wildfires in France this summer
evidence: On Thursday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said nearly 7,000 fires had broken out since the start of the summer season, with about 8,700 hectares burned so far.
